lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce2Cu6Te8 (CeCu3Te4) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cu in two environments: a tetrahedral motif with four Te neighbors and a four-vertex coordination polyhedron, while Te centers show 5- or 6-fold geometric coordination. The same analysis finds corner- and edge-sharing between Cu tetrahedra, and between Cu tetrahedra and 6-vertex Cu polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites.
